source: Client brief 2026-10-13 (Global Lactoferrin Market: definition, segmentation, exclusions); excluded segments removed entirely
market_definition: The Global Lactoferrin Market covers lactoferrin ingredients and products derived from bovine, human, recombinant and other sources, used across nutritional, pharmaceutical, food and beverage, animal nutrition and personal care applications. Lactoferrin is an iron-binding glycoprotein valued for its immune-supporting, antimicrobial and nutritional properties. The market includes lactoferrin supplied in powder, liquid, capsule, tablet and other forms, in standard (70-90%), high-purity (90-98%) and ultra-high-purity (98% and above) grades, for infant formula, dietary supplements, functional foods and beverages, medical nutrition, pharmaceutical formulations, animal nutrition and cosmetics and personal care, sold direct and through distributors.
core_scope: A core player itself produces lactoferrin and supplies it commercially under its own name: bovine lactoferrin isolated from milk or whey, human or recombinant lactoferrin made by precision fermentation or other expression systems and commercially supplied, in powder, liquid, capsule, tablet or other forms and any purity grade -- including dairy and ingredient groups for which lactoferrin is one product line, and producers that also sell their own lactoferrin as finished capsules or tablets.
adjacent_segments: General dairy and milk-ingredient makers with no lactoferrin product (whey protein, casein, lactalbumin sold on their own)
Infant formula, supplement, functional food, pharmaceutical, animal feed and cosmetic brands that buy lactoferrin from others (the customers)
Products that do not contain lactoferrin as a separately identifiable ingredient
Dairy processing, extraction, chromatography and purification equipment makers
Research-stage biotechnology firms, laboratory and contract-research services with no commercially supplied lactoferrin
Distributors, traders and resellers of other companies' lactoferrin
scope: ONLY companies that produce lactoferrin and supply it commercially under their own name: bovine lactoferrin (isolated from milk or whey), human or recombinant lactoferrin (commercially supplied, not research-stage), in powder, liquid, capsule, tablet or other forms and standard, high-purity or ultra-high-purity grades; a dairy or ingredient group with a lactoferrin line qualifies. EXCLUDED: general dairy and milk-ingredient makers without lactoferrin (whey protein, casein, lactalbumin sold on their own); infant formula, supplement, food, beverage, pharmaceutical, animal feed and cosmetic brands that buy lactoferrin from others or do not contain it; dairy processing, extraction and purification equipment makers; research-stage technologies, laboratory services and biotech activities with no commercially supplied lactoferrin; distributors, traders and resellers.
